name: Paternity and accompanying-check-up leave (陪產檢及陪產假)
authority: 性別平等工作法第15條第5項 — 7 days on full wages, raised from 5 days on 2022-01-18; the employer may reclaim the sixth and seventh day from the Bureau of Labor Insurance.

name: Prenatal check-up leave (產檢假)
authority: 性別平等工作法第15條第4項 — 7 days on full wages.

name: Menstrual leave (生理假)

name: Family care leave (家庭照顧假)
authority: 性別平等工作法第20條 — 7 days a year, counted into the 14-day 事假 quota and therefore unpaid; from 2026-01-01 it may be taken by the hour (7 days = 56 hours). Applied 2026-09-18: the seven days count inside the fourteen of personal leave (性平法 §20; `consumes_code`).

name: Parental leave without pay (育嬰留職停薪)
authority: 性別平等工作法第16條 — after six months' service, unpaid leave until the child reaches three years of age, for at most two years per child; the 就業保險 parental allowance is 60% of the insured salary, topped up to 80%. name: Breastfeeding and milk-expressing time (哺乳及集乳時間)
authority: 性別平等工作法第18條 — 60 minutes a day for a child under two, with a further 30 minutes where extended work exceeds one hour; the time counts as paid working time.

name: 住院傷病假 (hospitalised sickness leave)

name: 公假 (official leave)
authority: 勞工請假規則 §8: leave with pay for the days the law requires the worker to attend to a public duty — military service call-up, a summons, an election; not metered.

name: 謀職假 (job-search leave)

name: 補休 (time off in lieu of overtime pay)
authority: 勞動基準法 §32-1; 施行細則 §22-2 — the hours of 補休 the worker takes for overtime or 休息日 work they elected to take as time off (`work_days.time_off_in_lieu`). HR records each absence by the hour; the balance is not a leave entitlement: payroll keeps it from the elected days, consumes the oldest hours first, and pays what is untaken at the agreed expiry or on termination (`work_rules.time_off_in_lieu`). A paid day off: the wage is not reduced.

name: Annual leave (特別休假)

name: Bereavement leave (喪假)

name: Occupational injury leave (公傷病假)

name: Paternity and accompanying-check-up leave (陪產檢及陪產假)
authority: 性別平等工作法第15條第5項 — 7 days on full wages, raised from 5 days on 2022-01-18; the employer may reclaim the sixth and seventh day from the Bureau of Labor Insurance.

name: Prenatal check-up leave (產檢假)
authority: 性別平等工作法第15條第4項 — 7 days on full wages.

name: Menstrual leave (生理假)
authority: 性別平等工作法第14條 — one day a month; up to three days a year are not counted against the 30-day ordinary sickness quota and days beyond three are counted into it. Every day is at half wages. name: Parental leave without pay (育嬰留職停薪)

HR records each absence by the hour; the balance is not a leave entitlement: payroll keeps it from the elected days, consumes the oldest hours first, and pays what is untaken at the agreed expiry or on termination (`work_rules.time_off_in_lieu`). A paid day off: the wage is not reduced.

name: Annual leave (特別休假)
authority: 勞動基準法第38條 — 3 days after six months' continuous service, 7 after one year, 10 after two, 14 after three, 15 after five and one further day for every year beyond ten, capped at 30; the worker schedules the days and any unused day is paid out at the year end or on termination. Applied 2026-09-23 (round 2): 僱用部分時間工作勞工應行注意事項 (MOL, amended 2022-03-14) 三(三)–(四): a part-timer’s 特別休假 is their normal hours a year over a full-timer’s × the LSA §38 days, and 婚喪事病假 hours are their average weekly hours ÷ 40 × the days × 8. `entitlement.scale` states both in the part-timer’s own days (× 8 ÷ their hours a day), so a part-timer working the full-timer’s five days on shorter hours keeps the §38 days, as the guideline’s proviso requires. authority: 勞工請假規則第7條 — not more than 14 days a year, unpaid; from 2026-01-01 it may be taken by the hour where it is used to care for a family member.

name: Marriage leave (婚假)
authority: 勞工請假規則第2條 — 8 days on full wages.

name: Bereavement leave (喪假)

name: Occupational injury leave (公傷病假)
authority: 勞工請假規則第6條 with 勞動基準法第59條 — leave for the whole period of medical treatment and recuperation for an occupational injury or disease, with no day cap, at the 原領工資數額.

name: Maternity leave (產假)
authority: 性別平等工作法第15條第1項 with 勞動基準法第50條 — 8 weeks before and after childbirth; 4 weeks for a miscarriage at three months or more, 1 week at two months to under three, 5 days under two months. name: Paternity and accompanying-check-up leave (陪產檢及陪產假)
authority: 性別平等工作法第15條第5項 — 7 days on full wages, raised from 5 days on 2022-01-18; the employer may reclaim the sixth and seventh day from the Bureau of Labor Insurance.

name: Prenatal check-up leave (產檢假)
authority: 性別平等工作法第15條第4項 — 7 days on full wages.

name: Menstrual leave (生理假)
authority: 性別平等工作法第14條 — one day a month; up to three days a year are not counted against the 30-day ordinary sickness quota and days beyond three are counted into it. Every day is at half wages. name: Family care leave (家庭照顧假)
authority: 性別平等工作法第20條 — 7 days a year, counted into the 14-day 事假 quota and therefore unpaid; from 2026-01-01 it may be taken by the hour (7 days = 56 hours). Applied 2026-09-18: the seven days count inside the fourteen of personal leave (性平法 §20; `consumes_code`), and from 1 January 2026 may be taken by the hour (`unit: HOUR`).

name: Parental leave without pay (育嬰留職停薪)
authority: 性別平等工作法第16條 — after six months' service, unpaid leave until the child reaches three years of age, for at most two years per child; the 就業保險 parental allowance is 60% of the insured salary, topped up to 80%. From 2026-01-01 it may be claimed by the day for periods under 30 days, 30 days per parent and 60 per couple.

name: Breastfeeding and milk-expressing time (哺乳及集乳時間)
authority: 性別平等工作法第18條 — 60 minutes a day for a child under two, with a further 30 minutes where extended work exceeds one hour; the time counts as paid working time.

name: 住院傷病假 (hospitalised sickness leave)
authority: 勞工請假規則 §4(1)(2)–(3): up to one year of hospitalised sickness leave within any two years, and the non-hospitalised and hospitalised days together not more than one year within two; outpatient cancer treatment and 安胎休養 count as hospitalised. §4(2): half pay for the days inside thirty a year, none beyond (the 勞保 sickness benefit stands in). Applied 2026-09-18 as a rolling twenty-four-month pool of 365 days the outpatient row draws on too.

name: 公假 (official leave)
authority: 勞工請假規則 §8: leave with pay for the days the law requires the worker to attend to a public duty — military service call-up, a summons, an election; not metered.

name: 謀職假 (job-search leave)

authority: 勞工請假規則 §7(1) ordinary personal leave is at most 14 unpaid days annually; the 2025-12-09 §7(2) amendment, effective 2026-01-01 under §12(2), grants an hourly unit only where the employee personally cares for a family member. Use the separate FAMILY_CARE_LEAVE row for that case; it consumes this 14-day quota. https://laws.mol.gov.tw/FLAW/FLAWDOC01.aspx?flno=7&id=FL014935

name: Marriage leave (婚假)
authority: 勞工請假規則第2條 — 8 days on full wages.

name: Bereavement leave (喪假)
authority: 勞工請假規則第3條 — 8 days on the death of a parent, adoptive or foster parent, or spouse; 6 days for a grandparent, child, or the spouse's parent or adoptive/foster parent; 3 days for a great-grandparent, sibling, or the spouse's grandparent. All are on full wages. Applied 2026-09-18: eight days for a parent, step-parent or spouse; six for a grandparent, child or parent-in-law; three for a great-grandparent, sibling or spouse’s grandparent (勞工請假規則 §3; `event.relationship`), per death. Applied 2026-09-19 (2): 勞工請假規則 §3: eight days for a parent, step- or adoptive parent or spouse; six for a grandparent, child, or the spouse’s parent, step- or adoptive parent; three for a great-grandparent, sibling or the spouse’s grandparent — and no days for any other relationship.

name: Occupational injury leave (公傷病假)
authority: 勞工請假規則第6條 with 勞動基準法第59條 — leave for the whole period of medical treatment and recuperation for an occupational injury or disease, with no day cap, at the 原領工資數額.

name: Maternity leave (產假)
authority: 性別平等工作法第15條第1項 with 勞動基準法第50條 — 8 weeks before and after childbirth; 4 weeks for a miscarriage at three months or more, 1 week at two months to under three, 5 days under two months. Wages are paid in full where service is six months or more and at half where it is less. Applied 2026-09-18: a grant per event — eight weeks for a birth, four for a miscarriage after three months of pregnancy, one week after two, five days under two (勞基法 §50(1), 性平法 §15; `event.kind`) — at full wages after six months’ service, half before (§50(2); `pay_fraction`). Applied 2026-09-19 (2): 勞基法 §50(2): full pay after six months’ service, half before, for the eight weeks and the four-week leave for a miscarriage after three months of pregnancy; 性別平等工作法 §15(1): the one-week and five-day leaves for an earlier miscarriage are leave the employer need not pay.

name: Paternity and accompanying-check-up leave (陪產檢及陪產假)
authority: 性別平等工作法第15條第5項 — 7 days on full wages, raised from 5 days on 2022-01-18; the employer may reclaim the sixth and seventh day from the Bureau of Labor Insurance.

name: Prenatal check-up leave (產檢假)
authority: 性別平等工作法第15條第4項 — 7 days on full wages.

name: Menstrual leave (生理假)
authority: 性別平等工作法第14條 — one day a month; up to three days a year are not counted against the 30-day ordinary sickness quota and days beyond three are counted into it. Every day is at half wages. Applied 2026-09-18 (4): 性別平等工作法 §14: one day a month; three days a year are outside the thirty-day ordinary sickness quota and every day beyond them counts into it (`consumes_code`, `consumes_after_days`).

name: Family care leave (家庭照顧假)
authority: 性別平等工作法第20條 — 7 days a year, counted into the 14-day 事假 quota and therefore unpaid; from 2026-01-01 it may be taken by the hour (7 days = 56 hours). Applied 2026-09-18: the seven days count inside the fourteen of personal leave (性平法 §20; `consumes_code`), and from 1 January 2026 may be taken by the hour (`unit: HOUR`).

name: Parental leave without pay (育嬰留職停薪)
authority: 性別平等工作法第16條 — after six months' service, unpaid leave until the child reaches three years of age, for at most two years per child; the 就業保險 parental allowance is 60% of the insured salary, topped up to 80%. From 2026-01-01 it may be claimed by the day for periods under 30 days, 30 days per parent and 60 per couple.

name: Breastfeeding and milk-expressing time (哺乳及集乳時間)
authority: 性別平等工作法第18條 — 60 minutes a day for a child under two, with a further 30 minutes where extended work exceeds one hour; the time counts as paid working time.

name: 住院傷病假 (hospitalised sickness leave)
authority: 勞工請假規則 §4(1)(2)–(3): up to one year of hospitalised sickness leave within any two years, and the non-hospitalised and hospitalised days together not more than one year within two; outpatient cancer treatment and 安胎休養 count as hospitalised. §4(2): half pay for the days inside thirty a year, none beyond (the 勞保 sickness benefit stands in). Applied 2026-09-18 as a rolling twenty-four-month pool of 365 days the outpatient row draws on too.

name: 公假 (official leave)
authority: 勞工請假規則 §8: leave with pay for the days the law requires the worker to attend to a public duty — military service call-up, a summons, an election; not metered.

name: 謀職假 (job-search leave)
authority: 勞基法 §16(2) (https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=N0030001&flno=16): 勞工於接到前項預告後，為另謀工作得於工作時間請假外出。其請假時數，每星期不得超過二日之工作時間，請假期間之工資照給 — paid leave to look for work after the §16(1) notice of an employer termination under §11 or the §13 proviso; §20 applies the same periods. Corrected in place 2026-09-28 (round 6, a transcription error in every version): the grant followed exit_reason REDUNDANCY alone; it now follows the notice ground as SEVERANCE_PAY’s notice pay does (`exit_facts.lsa_termination_ground`, else REDUNDANCY or RETRENCHMENT read as §11). Corrected in place 2026-09-29 (a transcription omission in every version): the two-working-day weekly limit is `weekly_days` 2, counted Monday to Sunday, and a day is granted only inside the notice — fewer calendar days before exit_date than `exit_facts.notice_days_given` (the days from the day after notice to the last working day, 民法 §120(2); register TW-LEAVE-08). No recorded actual notice means no §16(2) leave, because the worker has not been shown to have received the preceding §16(1) notice.
eligibility: employment.exit_date != "" && ("lsa_termination_ground" in employment.exit_facts && employment.exit_facts.lsa_termination_ground != "" ? employment.exit_facts.lsa_termination_ground in ["ARTICLE_11", "ARTICLE_13_PROVISO", "ARTICLE_20"] : employment.exit_reason in ["REDUNDANCY", "RETRENCHMENT"]) && "notice_days_given" in employment.exit_fact_keys && employment.exit_facts.notice_days_given > 0.0 && employment.days_to_exit < employment.exit_facts.notice_days_given

name: 例假補假 (statutory rest day in lieu)
authority: 勞動基準法 §40: 因天災、事變或突發事件停止 §36 例假者，工資應加倍發給，並應於事後補假休息 — the day off in lieu HR credits on this row, a day for each statutory rest day worked (payroll prices the day itself at a further day’s wage, REST-STATUTORY-DOUBLE).

name: 補休 (time off in lieu of overtime pay)
authority: 勞動基準法 §32-1; 施行細則 §22-2 — the hours of 補休 the worker takes for overtime or 休息日 work they elected to take as time off (`work_days.time_off_in_lieu`). HR records each absence by the hour; the balance is not a leave entitlement: payroll keeps it from the elected days, consumes the oldest hours first, and pays what is untaken at the agreed expiry or on termination (`work_rules.time_off_in_lieu`). A paid day off: the wage is not reduced.
